description: Institute of Policy Studies of Sri Lanka (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-25
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H. E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to present the Institute of Policy Studies of Sri Lanka (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
